integrity: The all-parameter proof derives the equivariant alternating chain character and applies explicit Pieri identities. Reproducible finite character and rank calculations provide corroboration, not infinite proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Rational S_n-relabeling representation only; n>=6 and 3<=k<=n-3 at inclusive Rips scale one. The earlier wedge classification is prior work. Other equivalent indexed or unindexed literature cannot be excluded by search alone; numerical verification is finite.
title: Multiplicity-free symmetric-group homology of Johnson-graph Rips complexes
